package e2e

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"OPERATIONS_MODULE/game/purchase"
	"OPERATIONS_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"OPERATIONS_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	svcplatform "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/platform"
)

func operationsAssets(s *suite, sid int32, id, coins, applied int64) {
	s.t.Helper()
	s.eventually("persisted wallet and purchase cursor", 15*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		raw, err := operationsPlayerDoc(s, sid, id)
		balance, cursor := operationsNumber(raw, "wallet", "1"), operationsNumber(raw, "purchase", "1")
		return err == nil && balance == coins && cursor == applied, fmt.Sprintf("wallet=%d applied=%d err=%v", balance, cursor, err)
	})
}

func TestOperationsGMHTTPMailAndRehome(t *testing.T) {
	s, _, _ := operationsSuite(t)
	games, _ := s.fullStack(procOptions{})
	p := s.login(games[0], "operationsgm")
	letter := map[string]any{"player_id": p.id, "subject": "operations acceptance", "body": "same request across game processes", "attachment": map[string]any{"type": "coins", "amount": 55}, "request_id": "operations-mail-stable", "note": "private acceptance"}
	operationsAdmin(s, games[0], "gm.mail.send", "", letter, false)
	first := operationsAdmin(s, games[0], "gm.mail.send", "operations", letter, true)
	second := operationsAdmin(s, games[0], "gm.mail.send", "operations", letter, true)
	id, ok := first["mail_id"].(string)
	if !ok || id == "" || second["mail_id"] != id {
		t.Fatalf("mail dedupe %v %v", first, second)
	}
	claim := call(p, msgid.MsgMailboxClaim, &pb.MailboxClaimRequest{MailID: id}, pb.MarshalMailboxClaimRequest, pb.UnmarshalMailboxClaimResponse)
	if claim.Code != 0 || claim.Amount != 55 || claim.Held != 55 {
		t.Fatalf("mail grant %+v", claim)
	}
	operationsAssets(s, 1000, p.id, 55, 0)
	operationsMove(s, games[0], p.id, 1001)
	p = s.login(games[1], "operationsgm")
	third := operationsAdmin(s, games[1], "gm.mail.send", "operations", letter, true)
	if third["mail_id"] != id {
		t.Fatalf("cross-process stable request created another mail: %v", third)
	}
	claim = call(p, msgid.MsgMailboxClaim, &pb.MailboxClaimRequest{MailID: id}, pb.MarshalMailboxClaimRequest, pb.UnmarshalMailboxClaimResponse)
	if claim.Code == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("settled mail unexpectedly granted again: %+v", claim)
	}
	operationsAssets(s, 1001, p.id, 55, 0)
	operationsAdmin(s, games[0], "gm.player.coins", "operations", map[string]any{"player_id": p.id, "delta": 1, "note": "old owner must refuse"}, false)
	operationsAssets(s, 1001, p.id, 55, 0)
	t.Log("PASS GM ops HTTP -> mail NATS -> TCP claim; same mail id across sid; final binding=1001, source absent, wallet=55; accepted checked separately from completion")
}

func operationsCallback(s *suite, payments svcplatform.Platform, id int64, orderID string, replay bool) svcplatform.Order {
	s.t.Helper()
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"order_id": orderID, "player_id": id, "channel": "demo", "product_id": "coins_100", "amount_minor": 99, "currency": "USD", "paid_at_unix": 1700000000})
	// 只使用生成工程的开发模拟渠道。HMAC 仍由正式 platform 校验。
	config, err := os.ReadFile(s.procs["platform"].config)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	secret := ""
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(config), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), "payment_secret:") {
			secret = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)[1]), "\"")
			break
		}
	}
	if secret == "" {
		s.t.Fatal("generated payment secret missing")
	}
	receipt, err := payments.HandleCallback(s.ctx, raw, svcplatform.SignPayload(raw, secret))
	if err != nil || !receipt.Delivered || receipt.Replayed != replay || receipt.Order.State != svcplatform.DeliveryDelivered || len(receipt.Order.PendingAttempts) != 0 {
		s.t.Fatalf("callback replay=%v: %+v %v", replay, receipt, err)
	}
	return receipt.Order
}

func operationsQueue(s *suite, id int64, next, acked string, pending int) map[string]string {
	s.t.Helper()
	fields, err := s.redis.HGetAll(s.ctx, purchase.StoragePrefix+":{"+strconv.FormatInt(id, 10)+"}").Result()
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	expectedFields := pending*2 + 1
	if acked != "" {
		expectedFields++
	}
	if fields["next"] != next || fields["acked"] != acked || len(fields) != expectedFields {
		s.t.Fatalf("queue next=%s acked=%s pending=%d: %v", next, acked, pending, fields)
	}
	return fields
}

func TestOperationsPurchaseCrashAcrossSIDAndRedisRestart(t *testing.T) {
	s, redis, control := operationsSuite(t)
	games, _ := s.fullStack(procOptions{})
	p := s.login(games[0], "operationspurchase")
	payments, err := svcplatform.NewBusClient(s.bus, "", 5*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	orderID := "operations-order-one"
	original := operationsCallback(s, payments, p.id, orderID, false)
	operationsCallback(s, payments, p.id, orderID, true)
	queued := operationsQueue(s, p.id, "1", "", 1)
	if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(control, "purchase-arm"), []byte(orderID), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request, err := pb.MarshalPurchaseCollectRequest(&pb.PurchaseCollectRequest{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.seq++
	err = wire.Write(p.conn, []*wire.Packet{{MsgID: msgid.MsgPurchaseCollect, Seq: p.seq, Payload: request}}, wire.DefaultMaxPayload)
	p.mu.Unlock()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var reached struct {
		PID      int    `json:"pid"`
		Order    string `json:"order"`
		Sequence uint64 `json:"sequence"`
		Player   int64  `json:"player"`
	}
	s.eventually("strict grant before Ack barrier", 20*time.Second, func() (bool, string) {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(control, "purchase-reached"))
		if err != nil {
			return false, err.Error()
		}
		err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &reached)
		return err == nil, fmt.Sprint(err)
	})
	if reached.PID != games[0].cmd.Process.Pid || reached.Order != orderID || reached.Sequence != 1 || reached.Player != p.id {
		t.Fatalf("wrong barrier %+v", reached)
	}
	operationsAssets(s, 1000, p.id, 100, 1)
	operationsQueue(s, p.id, "1", "", 1)
	s.stop(games[0], syscall.SIGKILL)
	status, ok := games[0].exitErr.(*exec.ExitError)
	if !ok || status.Sys().(syscall.WaitStatus).Signal() != syscall.SIGKILL {
		t.Fatalf("source did not SIGKILL: %v", games[0].exitErr)
	}
	if err = os.Remove(filepath.Join(control, "purchase-arm")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// 先停依赖 Redis 的所有服务，避免把 Redis 的停止误当成 singleton 接管实验。
	s.stopAll()
	redis.stop()
	redis.start()
	if got := operationsQueue(s, p.id, "1", "", 1); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, queued) {
		t.Fatalf("AOF restart changed pending snapshot: before=%v after=%v", queued, got)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"account", "activity", "chat", "global", "mail", "match", "platform", "rank", "session", "alliance-3000", "alliance-3001", "game-1000", "game-1001"} {
		p := s.procs[name]
		s.start(name, p.service, p.sid, procOptions{})
	}
	order, found, err := payments.Order(s.ctx, orderID)
	if err != nil || !found || !reflect.DeepEqual(order, original) {
		t.Fatalf("platform order changed on AOF restart: %+v vs %+v err=%v", order, original, err)
	}
	operationsQueue(s, p.id, "1", "", 1)
	operationsMove(s, games[0], p.id, 1001)
	p = s.login(games[1], "operationspurchase") // enter 联动从新 sid 补领，同一 strict 游标不得再发奖。
	collect := call(p, msgid.MsgPurchaseCollect, &pb.PurchaseCollectRequest{}, pb.MarshalPurchaseCollectRequest, pb.UnmarshalPurchaseCollectResponse)
	if collect.Code != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("cross-sid replay collect: %+v", collect)
	}
	operationsAssets(s, 1001, p.id, 100, 1)
	operationsQueue(s, p.id, "1", "1", 0)
	operationsCallback(s, payments, p.id, orderID, true)
	operationsQueue(s, p.id, "1", "1", 0)
	operationsCallback(s, payments, p.id, "operations-order-two", false)
	collect = call(p, msgid.MsgPurchaseCollect, &pb.PurchaseCollectRequest{}, pb.MarshalPurchaseCollectRequest, pb.UnmarshalPurchaseCollectResponse)
	if collect.Code != 0 || len(collect.Receipts) != 1 || collect.Receipts[0].Sequence != 2 || collect.Receipts[0].OrderID != "operations-order-two" {
		t.Fatalf("next order %+v", collect)
	}
	operationsAssets(s, 1001, p.id, 200, 2)
	operationsQueue(s, p.id, "2", "2", 0)
	s.stop(games[1], syscall.SIGKILL)
	s.start(games[1].name, "game", 1001, procOptions{})
	p = s.login(games[1], "operationspurchase")
	collect = call(p, msgid.MsgPurchaseCollect, &pb.PurchaseCollectRequest{}, pb.MarshalPurchaseCollectRequest, pb.UnmarshalPurchaseCollectResponse)
	if collect.Code != 0 || len(collect.Receipts) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("cold retry %+v", collect)
	}
	operationsAssets(s, 1001, p.id, 200, 2)
	operationsQueue(s, p.id, "2", "2", 0)
	t.Log("PASS purchase NATS callback / TCP Collect / Mongo+WAL; kill after strict before Ack, Redis SIGKILL AOF same-dir restart, sid1000->1001; platform terminal immutable; pending=0 next=acked=Applied=2 wallet=200")
}
